notes: SiphonHook is an observe-only hook: afterSwap reads its own pool's sqrtPriceX96, tick, LP fee and liquidity from the PoolManager, optionally staticcalls getSlot0(bytes32) (selector 0xc815641c) on an owner-set anchor contract, and emits one PoolData(blockNumber, sqrtPriceSelf, tickSelf, sqrtPriceAnchor, tickAnchor, swapAmount, zeroForOne, feeAmount, liquidity) event per swap. It takes no hook fee, returns no delta, uses no transient storage, executes no swaps and holds no funds; the pool's 1.25% LP fee (fee 12500) is the launch policy's and is untouched. Permissions are exactly beforeInitialize and afterSwap (flags 0x2040). beforeInitialize accepts only the PoolManager as caller, imposes no fee, spacing, currency or sender rule, records the first pool's id in poolId and reverts PoolAlreadyInitialized for every later initialize naming the hook, so the factory opens the ETH/SIPH pool at fee 12500, spacing 60 without restriction and nobody can open a second pool whose swaps would emit PoolData from this address; afterSwap reads the recorded poolId. No liquidity callbacks exist, so the factory's zero-liquidity-change fee collect is unaffected. Constructor: (IPoolManager poolManager_, address owner_) -> ($poolManager, $owner); a zero owner reverts; the constructor runs Hooks.validateHookPermissions. Owner (0x735121a546092f31050a867fd7e3a750c7b0eff9 via $owner) may setAnchor(address, bytes32 poolId), setPaused(bool) and transferOwnership(address) (single-step, zero check only). The anchor starts as address(0) and the read is skipped until set; the staticcall gets at most 50,000 gas, and a failed, short or gas-burning anchor read reports zeros and never reverts the swap. Pause silences emission and skips the anchor read but never blocks swaps. feeAmount is a nominal estimate: the input actually paid times the pool LP fee over 1e6, ignoring any protocol fee. swapAmount is params.amountSpecified (negative = exact input). blockNumber is block.number, the L1 block number on Arbitrum Nitro chains such as Robinhood Chain. Spot prices in PoolData are raw per-swap observations, not an oracle. SiphonToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments, no owner, mint, pause, blocklist, fee or upgrade; supply is minted once to the deployer. Hook runtime is 2030 bytes, under 2 KB (via-IR, solc 0.8.26, cancun).
